k: It's cold. Colder than the water. Like it's breathing.
src: 'It\'s cold. Colder than the water. Like it\'s breathing.'

k: Don't touch it. Wren. _Wren._ Don't touch it.
src: 'Don\'t touch it. Wren. _Wren._ Don\'t touch it.'

k: Far away, the harbor bells begin to ring.
src: 'Far away, the harbor bells begin to ring.'

k: The ship! The Hierophant's ship is coming in!
src: 'The ship! The Hierophant\'s ship is coming in!'

k: And we're in a cave. Covered in eel. Wonderful.
src: 'And we\'re in a cave. Covered in eel. Wonderful.'

k: There was a purple crystal deep in the tide caves. Cold, like it was breathing. Ilse made me promise not to touch it.
src: 'There was a purple crystal deep in the tide caves. Cold, like it was breathing. Ilse made me promise not to touch it.'

k: A white ship with sails like folded wings. The Choir's sunburst on every one.
src: 'A white ship with sails like folded wings. The Choir\'s sunburst on every one.'

k: Keeper Ysolde. You haven't aged a day.
src: 'Keeper Ysolde. You haven\'t aged a day.'

k: Hierophant. You have.
src: 'Hierophant. You have.'

k: ...Ha. Honest as ever.
src: '...Ha. Honest as ever.'

k: And you must be Wren. The girl who writes me about the stars.
src: 'And you must be Wren. The girl who writes me about the stars.'

k: I— yes. Hello. Sir. Your Holiness? Your... Holy... sir.
src: 'I— yes. Hello. Sir. Your Holiness? Your... Holy... sir.'

k: Cassian will do.
src: 'Cassian will do.'

k: In your last letter you asked why the sun sets in the west and never in the east. I've brought you a book that doesn't answer that question at all — but asks it beautifully.
src: 'In your last letter you asked why the sun sets in the west and never in the east. I\'ve brought you a book that doesn\'t answer that question at all — but asks it beautifully.'

k: Received *The Sunward Atlas*.
src: 'Received *The Sunward Atlas*.'

k: _(whispering)_ You're glowing.
src: '_(whispering)_ You\'re glowing.'

k: _(whispering)_ I am _not_.
src: '_(whispering)_ I am _not_.'

k: May we speak tonight, Ysolde? At the Lantern.
src: 'May we speak tonight, Ysolde? At the Lantern.'

k: ...After supper.
src: '...After supper.'

k: Make way! Squire Bram Kestrel of the Dawnguard, reporting for honor-guard du— oh.
src: 'Make way! Squire Bram Kestrel of the Dawnguard, reporting for honor-guard du— oh.'

k: He's... already here. Of course he is.
src: 'He\'s... already here. Of course he is.'

k: Squire Kestrel. Sir Aldous spoke of you.
src: 'Squire Kestrel. Sir Aldous spoke of you.'

k: Did he.
src: 'Did he.'

k: He spoke well of you. Often.
src: 'He spoke well of you. Often.'

k: ...He would.
src: '...He would.'

k: Wren! Ilse! You saw that? He knew my name. The _Hierophant_ knew my name.
src: 'Wren! Ilse! You saw that? He knew my name. The _Hierophant_ knew my name.'

k: You smell like the inn, Bram.
src: 'You smell like the inn, Bram.'

k: Cider is a breakfast drink on islands. Everyone knows that.
src: 'Cider is a breakfast drink on islands. Everyone knows that.'

k: Hierophant Cassian arrived. He gave me a book! He knew my letters. Mom was... Mom.
src: 'Hierophant Cassian arrived. He gave me a book! He knew my letters. Mom was... Mom.'

k: He gave you a book.
src: 'He gave you a book.'

k: An atlas. Of the sun. Did you know there are cities in the east where it never quite gets dark in summer—
src: 'An atlas. Of the sun. Did you know there are cities in the east where it never quite gets dark in summer—'

k: Wren. What did he say to you?
src: 'Wren. What did he say to you?'

k: Nothing! He was _nice_. Is that so strange? That somebody important would be nice to me?
src: 'Nothing! He was _nice_. Is that so strange? That somebody important would be nice to me?'

k: Important people are nice when they want something.
src: 'Important people are nice when they want something.'

k: And what could he possibly want from _me_?
src: 'And what could he possibly want from _me_?'

k: After the Kindling... I want to go to Aurenne. Study at the Cathedral. He'd sponsor me, I know he would—
src: 'After the Kindling... I want to go to Aurenne. Study at the Cathedral. He\'d sponsor me, I know he would—'

k: You didn't even let me—
src: 'You didn\'t even let me—'

k: Tomorrow you'll be given your Crest. And then you'll learn the Lantern. As I did. As my mother did.
src: 'Tomorrow you\'ll be given your Crest. And then you\'ll learn the Lantern. As I did. As my mother did.'

k: Because _you_ never left, nobody can?
src: 'Because _you_ never left, nobody can?'

k: That night, a storm comes in off the Western Sea.
src: 'That night, a storm comes in off the Western Sea.'

k: Wren does not sleep.
src: 'Wren does not sleep.'

k: Lightning over the black rocks... wait.
src: 'Lightning over the black rocks... wait.'

k: There's someone down there. On the rocks. In _this_.
src: 'There\'s someone down there. On the rocks. In _this_.'

k: Mom and I fought. She said Dad would have gone with me. Then there was someone on the black rocks, in the storm.
src: 'Mom and I fought. She said Dad would have gone with me. Then there was someone on the black rocks, in the storm.'

k: A girl! And those— are those _dogs_?
src: 'A girl! And those— are those _dogs_?'

k: They are shaped like dogs the way smoke is shaped like a fire.
src: 'They are shaped like dogs the way smoke is shaped like a fire.'

k: Wren! You saw it too? From my window, the lightning—
src: 'Wren! You saw it too? From my window, the lightning—'

k: Ilse, stay back—
src: 'Ilse, stay back—'

k: Absolutely not. Who do you think is going to patch you up?
src: 'Absolutely not. Who do you think is going to patch you up?'

k: They're gone. Like smoke. Wren, what _were_ those?
src: 'They\'re gone. Like smoke. Wren, what _were_ those?'

k: Something rises out of the surf. Something that was a dog once, long ago, and has been at the bottom of the sea ever since.
src: 'Something rises out of the surf. Something that was a dog once, long ago, and has been at the bottom of the sea ever since.'

k: ...Ilse. Run.
src: '...Ilse. Run.'

k: We are _not_ leaving her.
src: 'We are _not_ leaving her.'

k: HALT, foul— uh— dog-thing! You face Bram Kestrel of the Dawnguard!
src: 'HALT, foul— uh— dog-thing! You face Bram Kestrel of the Dawnguard!'

k: Bram?!
src: 'Bram?!'

k: I saw your lanterns from the inn. Also I may have been awake for unrelated reasons. Stand behind me!
src: 'I saw your lanterns from the inn. Also I may have been awake for unrelated reasons. Stand behind me!'

k: Did you see that? I was magnificent.
src: 'Did you see that? I was magnificent.'

k: You fell over twice.
src: 'You fell over twice.'

k: She's breathing. Cold as the sea, but breathing.
src: 'She\'s breathing. Cold as the sea, but breathing.'

k: ...don't... let him find me...
src: '...don\'t... let him find me...'

k: Who? Let _who_ find you?
src: 'Who? Let _who_ find you?'

k: She's fainted. Nana's is closest. Bram — carry her.
src: 'She\'s fainted. Nana\'s is closest. Bram — carry her.'

k: Carrying. Yes. Very knightly. I am good at carrying.
src: 'Carrying. Yes. Very knightly. I am good at carrying.'

k: They carry her up the beach between them. The storm is already blowing itself out, grumbling away east over the strait.
src: 'They carry her up the beach between them. The storm is already blowing itself out, grumbling away east over the strait.'

k: Out past the black rocks the sea goes flat and quiet, as if nothing had ever come out of it at all.
src: 'Out past the black rocks the sea goes flat and quiet, as if nothing had ever come out of it at all.'

k: It's past midnight, Wren. Happy birthday.
src: 'It\'s past midnight, Wren. Happy birthday.'

k: ...In twelve hours I stand in the Lantern's light.
src: '...In twelve hours I stand in the Lantern\'s light.'

k: I don't think I'm going to sleep.
src: 'I don\'t think I\'m going to sleep.'

k: We fought shadow-dogs on the black rocks, and something that came out of the sea. Bram helped (he says he saved us). The girl from the storm said: "Don't let him find me."
src: 'We fought shadow-dogs on the black rocks, and something that came out of the sea. Bram helped (he says he saved us). The girl from the storm said: "Don\'t let him find me."'

k: Brackenmoor, north meadow
src: 'Brackenmoor, north meadow'

k: A boar the size of a hay cart. Has eaten two fences and a cart. The cart was occupied.
src: 'A boar the size of a hay cart. Has eaten two fences and a cart. The cart was occupied.'

k: Brackenmoor, the sunk pool
src: 'Brackenmoor, the sunk pool'

k: Something in the moor pool dangles a light at night. Travelers follow it. Travelers stop.
src: 'Something in the moor pool dangles a light at night. Travelers follow it. Travelers stop.'

k: Brackenmoor, the old cairns
src: 'Brackenmoor, the old cairns'

k: A cairn that got up and walked. It eats the other cairns. Bring a hammer.
src: 'A cairn that got up and walked. It eats the other cairns. Bring a hammer.'

k: Drowned Observatory, the causeway
src: 'Drowned Observatory, the causeway'

k: A crab that holds the causeway at low tide and takes a toll in fingers.
src: 'A crab that holds the causeway at low tide and takes a toll in fingers.'

k: Fort Ashwatch, the east yard
src: 'Fort Ashwatch, the east yard'

k: The fort's old war-hound, still on patrol. Nobody told it the war ended. Nobody can get close enough to tell it.
src: 'The fort\'s old war-hound, still on patrol. Nobody told it the war ended. Nobody can get close enough to tell it.'

k: The Ashen Reach, the high ridge
src: 'The Ashen Reach, the high ridge'

k: A gull that flew through the broken sun and came out burning. It has not stopped.
src: 'A gull that flew through the broken sun and came out burning. It has not stopped.'

k: The Ashen Reach, the glass hollows
src: 'The Ashen Reach, the glass hollows'

k: A scorpion that ate a cathedral window. You can see the saints through its back.
src: 'A scorpion that ate a cathedral window. You can see the saints through its back.'

k: The Ashen Reach, far shard
src: 'The Ashen Reach, far shard'

k: It lives in the old burial shard. It speaks with the voices of the people buried there.
src: 'It lives in the old burial shard. It speaks with the voices of the people buried there.'

k: The Hollow Bell, the inverted nave
src: 'The Hollow Bell, the inverted nave'

k: The abbey's choir-mistress, still conducting. The choir is gone. She has not noticed.
src: 'The abbey\'s choir-mistress, still conducting. The choir is gone. She has not noticed.'

k: The Garden That Remembers, the east beds
src: 'The Garden That Remembers, the east beds'

k: A rose-hedge in the shape of a bride. Do not let her hold your hand.
src: 'A rose-hedge in the shape of a bride. Do not let her hold your hand.'

k: {blue|[hunting]}
src: ' {blue|[hunting]}'

k: {dim|[done]}
src: ' {dim|[done]}'

k: Leave the board
src: 'Leave the board'

k: The bounty board
src: 'The bounty board'

k: Take the bounty?
src: 'Take the bounty?'

k: Take it
src: 'Take it'

k: That's every bounty on the board. Nobody's cleared it since the old man died.
src: 'That\'s every bounty on the board. Nobody\'s cleared it since the old man died.'
